title: Native GUI hierarchy: preparatory migration coverage inventory
scope: Main menu hierarchy plus focused tag/display/migration, subscription/import-option and downloader/parser/formula/string/sidecar dialog families. Remaining Slint windows are catalogued as unassessed.
caveats: Read-only static inventory; no Cargo, GUI, oracle or mutation tests were run.
Repository may be changing during third-slate integration; native_source anchors and file hashes describe the observed snapshot.
Statuses describe conservative slices, not an overall completion percentage. Callback presence does not demonstrate parity.
first_pass means reference-backed tests/recordings exist for the identified slice; their passing status was not rerun here.
partial means an implemented surface has known family limitations; unassessed means this inventory does not establish its behavior.
todo() and command-less check entries are missing; contextual disabled states, absent dynamic data and informational labels are not gaps.
Main Tags > migrate is currently todo while migration is reachable from service review and Manage Tags. These are separate nodes.
Parent relations marked inferred_from_native_open_calls are static navigation inference; shared-editor references are canonical aliases, not separately implemented editors.
Component catalog omits deeply expanded media context menus, all options/predicate choices, remote service/admin surfaces and much reference-only functionality.
No total reference feature denominator or parity percentage may be derived from these node counts.

Counts exceed the preferred 100–250 range because all static main-menu branches and remaining exported native window components are retained; focus expansion is limited to the requested editor families.

status_definitions.first_pass: Identified native slice with reference-backed regression evidence; broader parity not asserted.
status_definitions.partial: Implemented native slice with documented or family limitations.
status_definitions.missing: Explicit placeholder or documented unsupported native editing/action slice.
status_definitions.unassessed: Surface exists, but behavioral completion was not assessed.
